test_laplacian_smoothing_uniform: test the mesh laplacian smoothing loss with uniform weights against a naive reference implementation
test_laplacian_smoothing_cot: test the mesh laplacian smoothing loss with cotangent weights against a naive reference implementation
test_laplacian_smoothing_cotcurv: test the mesh laplacian smoothing loss with cotcurv weights against a naive reference implementation
init_meshes: create a batch of random PyTorch3D Meshes objects with configurable vertices and faces for testing
laplacian_smoothing_with_init: build a benchmark function that initializes random meshes and returns a callable to measure cotcurv smoothing performance
